description: Chrome-privileged bridge that injects an Add-link/Join control next to the Location field in Thunderbird's calendar event dialogs. Carries no auth/network logic itself — see background.js for that.

functions.name: configure
functions.description: Sets the backend origin used to detect existing meeting links, and the (already-localized) button labels to display.

functions.name: applyResult
functions.description: Delivers the outcome of a previously requested meeting link back to the dialog control that asked for it.

events.name: onAddRequested
events.description: Fired when the user clicks "Add a meeting link" in an event dialog.

events.name: onJoinRequested
events.description: Fired when the user clicks "Join" on an event whose Location already holds a meeting link.
